# docs: record work tracking decisions

## Why

Work tracking spans backlog intake, service workflows, and architecture governance. Contributors need a short record of the rules that govern those workflows and where each kind of work belongs.

## Behavior change

The wiki adds 13 decision records on issue intake and placement, service issues and approvals, managed content and validation, design publication, architecture decision records, and review content. The decision index links to each record.

## Decisions

- On 2026-11-22, tbhb decided the rules in records 0001 through 0004 and 0006 through 0011.
- On 2026-11-23, tbhb decided the rules in records 0005, 0012, and 0013.

## Verification

Checked the index links and descriptions against the records. The dates in the Decisions section match the records.
